purpose: Freeze the next evidence tests for JNU precision features without adding directional votes or rescuing terminal-failed families.

frozen_tests: Advance/decline breadth versus next-session JNU return and intraday path.
Top-4/top-10 contribution concentration versus next-session continuation/reversal.
Nikkei-versus-TOPIX divergence conditional on breadth.
VI level percentile and one-day delta versus subsequent realized JNU volatility.
Nikkei return versus VI divergence as a risk-state classifier.
Incremental value over VIX-only context.
2Y/10Y/30Y daily changes and 2s10s/10s30s slope versus JNU return/volatility.
BOJ event windows separated from non-event days.
No causal claim from daily yield moves alone.
Standardized actual-minus-consensus by release family.
Separate Japan and U.S. releases.
No backfilled consensus or post-release revisions.

candidates.source_status: JPX complete OHLC/1-minute/tick history is charged; trial historical tick data may be available subject to conditions.
frozen_tests: Trade imbalance, limit-order imbalance and spread-scaled imbalance.
Queue depletion and best-quote depth change.
Incremental predictive value after controlling for volatility/time-of-day.
Separate confirmed intervention windows from ordinary USDJPY shocks.
Measure JNU/USDJPY response and persistence after official intervention dates.
Day/night, open, cash-lunch boundary, close and macro-event windows.
Normalize volume, range and spread by time-of-day before comparing signals.
EPU regime versus Nikkei futures liquidity/illiquidity measures.
Incremental value beyond VIX, realized volatility and event-day controls.
Separate trade/tariff and FX-policy uncertainty where reproducible subindices exist.
Do not infer direction from high EPU alone.

required_promotion_sequence: True OSE Nikkei 225 mini individual-contract untouched OOS with costs and roll governance.
Compare incremental edge against generic prior-high breakout baseline.
Forward validation before any directional role.

completion_rule: Absence of authorized or rights-clean source data is a research blocker, not a reason to infer PASS or to create synthetic directional evidence.
